subject: wallfix RunPod session-level ABAB (PRs 3850, 3991, 4009), solve_cpu and solve_wall B/A
method: Independent stdlib recompute from the 36 run2 records.jsonl files: per session, sum over records with warmup == false of time.schedstat_solve.cpu_ns and time.solve_wall_ns over all arms; per (PR, spec, round) B/A; per (PR, spec) geometric mean (exp of mean log), min, max; aa_spread = max/min of A sums. Compared with results-ab.json at rel_tol 1e-9 (sums exactly). Checks: output identity of A vs B after dropping timing fields; every record verified with matches_target true; binary_sha256 bound to runlog-run2.tsv and binaries-run2.sha256 and A = first parent of merge B in git; hazards (warmup, cpu_ns quantisation, dominance, order, A/A control, isolation, self-audit). The producer's analysis code was not read.
